purpose: Audit whether self-building curriculum prompts expose the answer being scored.
answer_bearing_rules: variable prompts may expose bounded menus but not the selected key, literal, or value slot
result prompts may expose pre-decision measurements but not a candidate/cpu/final disposition assignment
scheduler prompts may expose the complete pre-decision matrix but not a marker that identifies the expected next slot
action prompts may expose approved template menus but not the selected template slot
template prompts may expose the complete template and variable menu but not a selected template or requested variable
raw model output remains the authorship source and is never repaired by the audit
